description: CAM6 physics boundary traces from an instrumented FSCAMARM97 (SCAM) run on the ne3np4 grid (PLAN.md 10.4 M2), default-gated by dump_cam=.false. and enabled in this run only: (a) D boundaries - instantaneous tendencies of every physics_update call in tphysbc/tphysac (physpkg.F90; 22 unique sites, 26 site-calls/step: 20 single sites plus clubb and microp repeated cld_macmic_num_steps=3 times in the macro-micro co-substep loop; macrop/microp_sc/carma_emis/carma_wetdep/nudging are gated off in this configuration - macrop_scheme='CLUBB_SGS', use_subcol_microp=.false., no CARMA, Nudge_Model=false; the SCM relaxation is dynamics-side in apply_iop_forcing.F90): the column state immediately before the update (T,u,v,s,pmid,pdel,ps,phis,zm,q_Q) plus the ptend to be applied (ptend_s/u/v, ptend_q_Q; per-constituent q_before/ptend_q in cam_phys_tend_q.csv) with the site context (dt, macmic substep, scale=1/cld_macmic_num_steps, top/bot levels, active flags, lat/lon); (b) cam_in/cam_out surface exchange per step (bc_in at tphysbc entry; bc_out after cam_export; ac_out at tphysac exit; cam_in%cflx per constituent in cam_surface_cflx.csv); (c) the wv_saturation qsat law (T,pmid -> es,qs,gam; Goff-Gratch mixed-phase table) at entry to tphysbc and tphysac; (d) accumulated tend%dtdt/dudt/dvdt at the end of tphysbc and tphysac.

regenerate.command:
source stage1/runs/env.sh && python3 stage1/cesm/cime/scripts/create_newcase --case stage1/cime/cases/FSCAMARM97_ne3_cam_inst --compset FSCAMARM97 --res ne3_ne3_mg37 --machine illinois --run-unsupported --srcroot stage1/EqESM-cesm-cam && cd stage1/cime/cases/FSCAMARM97_ne3_cam_inst && ./xmlchange STOP_OPTION=nhours,STOP_N=24,JOB_WALLCLOCK_TIME=06:00:00 && printf 'dump_cam = .true.
dump_dir = '.../stage1/dumps/cam/'
dump_first_steps = 48
' >> user_nl_cam && ./case.setup && ./case.build && env -u SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE -u SLURM_MEM_PER_CPU -u SLURM_MEM_PER_GPU ./case.submit
regenerate.note: Model source root is the fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cam (branch instrument/cam-dumps; cam submodule @d6230637 = cam6_4_212 + dump module incl. the ptend-name sanitization fix; nested submodules cice/src/icepack, clm/src/fates, cam-sima sparse, atmos_phys schemes pumas/mmm/rrtmgp/ext/tempo, hemco/HEMCO, geoschem KPP/standalone initialized to match the pristine checkout); CIME scripts come from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. Dump CSVs land in stage1/dumps/cam/ (set by dump_dir in user_nl_cam). Full dumps are gitignored and regenerable; a 24-h run takes ~1 h wall. NOTE (2026-11-02): inputdata/share/domains/domain.lnd.ne3np4_gx3v7.230718.nc was missing from the shared inputdata tree (both initial runs SIGSEGV'd in esm_get_single_column_attributes); it was reconstructed from the ne3np4 mesh (element centers/areas, mask=frac=0 ocean column to reproduce the reference run's scol_lndfrac=0 behavior - see CAM_LANE.md and bugs.md #20; a land-column v1 reconstruction aborted both runs at step ~17 via CLM's flwds<=0 check). Restore the original file if it resurfaces.

namelist_deltas.note: All other settings identical to the reference run FSCAMARM97_ne3 (deep_scheme='ZM', shallow_scheme='CLUBB_SGS', macrop_scheme='CLUBB_SGS', cld_macmic_num_steps=3, MG/PUMAS microphysics, rrtmg radiation, trop_mam4 chemistry, use_gw_*=.false., scm_relaxation=.true., iopfile ARM97_4scam.nc, pver=32). Verified solution-neutral: the instrumented run's cam.h0i/cam.h0a are bit-identical (modulo title/timestamp attributes) to the reference run, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled.

dump_files.cam_phys_tend.csv: step,ymd,tod,site,proc_name,active,lu,lv,ls,nlq,top_level,bot_level,macmic_it,macmic_num,dt,scale,lev,lat,lon,T,u,v,s,pmid,pdel,ps,phis,zm,q_Q,ptend_s,ptend_u,ptend_v,ptend_q_Q - one row per (step, physics_update call site, level); state columns are the column state immediately before the update (physpkg.F90 tphysbc/tphysac calls to physics_update, physics_types.F90:207); site is the call-site label (energy_fixer..nudging, see CAM_LANE.md table); proc_name is ptend%name ('none' when empty); active=1 if any ptend field set; lu/lv/ls = ptend%lu/lv/ls; nlq = count(ptend%lq); top_level/bot_level = ptend%top_level/bot_level; macmic_it/macmic_num = macro-micro co-substep index and cld_macmic_num_steps (0/1 outside the loop; macrop/clubb/microp_sc/microp repeat macmic_num times per step); dt = physics timestep [s]; scale = ptend scaling (1/cld_macmic_num_steps inside the macmic loop); T [K] u [m/s] v [m/s] s [J/kg] pmid [Pa] pdel [Pa] ps [Pa] phis [m2/s2] zm [m] q_Q [kg/kg] = state before update; ptend_s [J/kg/s] ptend_u/v [m/s2] ptend_q_Q [kg/kg/s] = tendencies to be applied (0 outside [top_level,bot_level] or when the flag is not set); lat/lon [deg]
dump_files.cam_phys_tend_q.csv: step,ymd,tod,site,lev,cnst_idx,cnst_name,q_before,ptend_q - one row per (step, site, level, constituent) for every constituent in ptend%lq (physics_types.F90:145); q_before [kg/kg] = state%q immediately before the update; ptend_q [kg/kg/s] = tendency; joins to cam_phys_tend.csv on (step,site,lev)
dump_files.cam_surface_exchange.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,asdir,asdif,aldir,aldif,lwup,lhf,shf,wsx,wsy,tref,qref,u10,ts,sst,snowhland,snowhice,landfrac,icefrac,ocnfrac,cflx_Q,tbot,zbot,ubot,vbot,qbot_Q,pbot,rho,netsw,flwds,precsc,precsl,precc,precl,soll,sols,solld,solsd,thbot,psl,co2prog,co2diag,ozone - phase=bc_in = cam_in at entry to tphysbc (physpkg.F90:2325; surface albedos asdir/asdif/aldir/aldif, lwup [W/m2], lhf/shf [W/m2], wsx/wsy [N/m2], tref [K]/qref [kg/kg], u10 [m/s], ts/sst [K], snowhland/snowhice [m], landfrac/icefrac/ocnfrac, cflx_Q [kg/m2/s]; camsrfexch.F90:86); phase=bc_out = cam_out after cam_export (physpkg.F90:3119), phase=ac_out = cam_out at end of tphysac (physpkg.F90:2095; tbot [K] zbot [m] ubot/vbot [m/s] qbot_Q [kg/kg] pbot [Pa] rho [kg/m3], netsw [W/m2], flwds [W/m2], precsc/precsl/precc/precl [m/s] snow-conv/snow-large-scale/conv/large-scale precip, soll/sols/solld/solsd [W/m2], thbot [K] psl [Pa] co2prog/co2diag [mol/mol] ozone [mol/mol]; camsrfexch.F90:37); cam_in fields are 0 for bc_out/ac_out and cam_out fields are 0 for bc_in
dump_files.cam_surface_cflx.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,cnst_idx,cnst_name,cflx - cam_in%cflx surface constituent fluxes [kg/m2/s] per constituent (camsrfexch.F90:113), phase=bc_in only
dump_files.cam_qsat.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,lev,T,pmid,es,qs,gam - wv_saturation qsat law at entry to tphysbc (phase=bc, physpkg.F90:2326) and tphysac (phase=ac, physpkg.F90:1491): T [K] = state%t, pmid [Pa] = state%pmid; es [Pa] = saturation vapor pressure (estblf table lookup on the Goff-Gratch mixed-phase table, wv_saturation.F90:378), qs [kg/kg] = saturation specific humidity (svp_to_qsat = epsilo*es/(p-omeps*es), wv_sat_methods.F90:185), gam = (hltalt/cpair)*(dqsdt) with the pcf transition polynomial (wv_saturation.F90:521-600); computed by qsat_2D (wv_saturation.F90:851)
dump_files.cam_tend_total.csv: step,ymd,tod,phase,lev,dtdt,dudt,dvdt - accumulated physics tendencies: phase=bc = end of tphysbc (before coupling), phase=ac = end of tphysac (full step); dtdt [K/s] = tend%dtdt (accumulated ptend%s/cpairv, physics_types.F90:417-419), dudt/dvdt [m/s2] = tend%dudt/dvdt (physics_types.F90:289-300); tend is zeroed at the top of tphysbc (physpkg.F90:2326)

traced_domain.cells: the single SCAM column (ncol=1 at 96.708W, 36.520N = ne3np4 mesh element 348, the nearest mesh element to PTS_LAT=36.6/PTS_LON=262.5)
traced_domain.steps: first 48 physics steps (dump_first_steps=48) of the 48-step 24-h run; every physics_update call in tphysbc/tphysac is traced on those steps
traced_domain.steps_note: cam_phys_tend.csv has 48 x 26 site-calls x 32 lev = 39936 rows (26 = 20 single sites + clubb x3 + microp x3; 22 unique sites); cam_phys_tend_q.csv has 48 x sum(site lq count) x 32 rows; cam_qsat/cam_tend_total 48 x 2 x 32 = 3072 rows each; cam_surface_exchange 48 x 3 = 144 rows; cam_surface_cflx 48 x pcnst = 1632 rows (pcnst = 34).

checks.bit_identical_outputs: VERIFIED (2026-11-02): instrumented h0i is bit-identical to the pristine run h0i over all 48 records and all variables; the only differences are the case global attribute and the time_written char variable (write timestamps). So the dump code changes nothing in the solution (stage1/analysis/compare_cam_hist.py)
checks.qsat_law: es = estblf(T) (Goff-Gratch mixed-phase table, linear interpolation), qs = epsilo*es/(p-omeps*es), es=min(es,p), gam = (hltalt/cpair)*qs*p*desdt/(es*(p-omeps*es)) with desdt = hltalt*es/(rh2o*T^2)+tterm (pcf polynomial) to round-off on all 3072 rows
checks.row_counts: VERIFIED: cam_phys_tend 39936 = 48 x 26 site-calls x 32 lev; cam_phys_tend_q 511488 = 48 x sum(calls x lq x 32), consistent with the ptend nlq column; cam_qsat/cam_tend_total 3072; cam_surface_exchange 144; cam_surface_cflx 1632 = 48 x pcnst (34); no blank lines, no trailing commas
checks.site_order: per-step site order matches the tphysbc/tphysac call sequence; clubb/microp repeat with macmic_it=1..3 and scale=1/3 (interleaved); the other 20 sites once each
checks.surface_consistency: bc_out cam_out == ac_out cam_out on all steps; cflx_Q matches the cam_surface_cflx row for Q
checks.precip: VERIFIED: 15/48 steps have nonzero precip at bc_out (precc max 1.01e-8 m/s at step 48, precl max 6.5e-14 m/s at step 47); ARM97 observed precip is nonzero from IOP hour 19, model starts at IOP hour 23.5

stage2_ranking.1_qsat: wv_saturation qsat law (wv_saturation.F90 qsat_2D + wv_sat_methods.F90): pure table+formula law, fully pinned by cam_qsat.csv with no pbuf state; first stage-2 target.
stage2_ranking.2_energy_fixer: energy_fixer.F90: closed-form column energy fix, site 1 of tphysbc.
stage2_ranking.4_convect_deep: ZM deep convection (convect_deep.F90): dominant precip source in ARM97; large but high-value chain.
stage2_ranking.5_microp: MG/PUMAS microphysics: largest, most coupled (needs cam_phys_tend_q + pbuf context); defer.
stage2_ranking.6_clubb: CLUBB_SGS (macrop/clubb/shallow): state-dependent closure with pbuf state; defer behind ZM.
